simple.meaning: מִצְפָּה (Mitspâh) appears 36 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a daughter in the family line.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Joshua, Judges, 1 Samuel, 1 Kings, and 5 more, beginning at Genesis 31:49. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִצְפָּה (H4709) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows מִצְפָּה through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.

definitions.short: Mitspah , the name of two places in Palestine
definitions.usage: Mitspah. (This seems rather to be only an orthographic variation of 4708 when 'in pause'.)
definitions.full: H4709. Mitspah מִצְמָּה 38 proper name, of a location (properly outlook-point or +? ; with article (exceptHos Josh 5:1 )); — 1 in Gilead , explanation as name given to Laban's cairn, north of Jabbok Gen 31:49 (on text see Ball Holz; ᵐ5 ἡ ὅρασις ). 2 probably south of Jabbok, Judg 10:17 ( ἡ σκοπιά ), 11:11 , 34 ( Μασσηφα ; so ᵐ5 L 10:17 ), Hosea 5:1 ( ἡ σκοπιά ); apparently = II. מִצְמֶּה 3 , Buhl Geogr. 262 ( מֶּה -, מָּה -, seem to interchange); site unknown; see conjectures in Buhl l.c. , compare GASm Geogr. 586. 3 . near Hermon , הַמּ ׳אֶרֶץ Josh 11:3 , Μασευμαν , Μασσηφα ( θ ), = בִּקְעַתמִֿצְמֶּה 11:8 , Μασσωχ , Μασσηφα ; see Buhl Geogr. 240. 4 old sacred place in Benjamin , Μασσηφα , etc.; — ׳הַמּ Judg 20:1 +, הַמִּצְמָּ֫תָה 1Sam 7:5 +; — Judg 20:1 , 3 ; 21:1 , 5 , 8 ; 1Sam 7:5 7 t. 1 Samuel 7; 1 Samuel 10; 1Kin 15:22 2Chr 16:6 ; 2Kin 25:23 , 25 ; Jer 40:10 12 t. 40, 41; Neh 3:7 , 15 , 19 ; = הַמִּצְמֶּה Josh 18:26 ; — modern Nabî Samwîl , 5 miles northwest of Jerusalem, see Buhl Geogr. 167 f. .
